crossRefs.note: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which Yahweh’s tribute was sixty-one.

translations.web: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which Yahweh’s tribute was sixty-one.
translations.bsb: 30,500 donkeys, including a tribute to the LORD of 61,
translations.kjv: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD'S tribute was threescore and one.
translations.asv: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which Jehovah's tribute was threescore and one.
